# LectureText

This release includes the Windows installer and an unsigned macOS .dmg.

## What's new

- The app is named LectureText.
- Notes stay as Markdown until you choose Generate PDF. Changing a note removes its outdated PDF.
- Lecture titles sort by name or date from the control beside Modules. Name and date each keep their own direction.
- The window uses the dark purple glow from the LectureText landing page.

## Install on Windows

1. Download the Windows installer from this release.
2. Run the installer.
3. Open LectureText.

## Install on macOS

1. Download the unsigned macOS .dmg from this release.
2. Open the disk image and move LectureText into Applications.
3. Allow the unsigned app once in System Settings, under Privacy & Security, then open LectureText.
